weight_application: decision weights forward-filled and shifted one trading day
turnover_basis: absolute changes in applied target weights
trend_rule: lagged close above lagged 200-day moving average; SHY, IEF and TLT always eligible
dual_momentum_rule: lagged 12-month momentum excluding 21 trading days; top three positive assets; residual to SHY
notes: This configuration describes the archived pre-upgrade engine. It is evidence, not the frozen confirmation protocol.
